description:
Land %VText/VLines/VFlow/VRow/VBox/VZone/VMemo/VHole/VCursor structs
and the single-pass painter (LineBuf as {iolist_rev,
line_iolist_rev, visible_width, line_count}).

Memo cell shape: {iodata, visible_width, cursor_offset_or_nil} so
cursor coords survive cache hits.

Surfaced by the streaming-Markdown worked example (§13 of the
deck), four small framework rules:

  1. **Children as iodata.** `%VFlow{children}` and
     `%VRow{children}` accept a child that is either a single
     VNode or a (possibly nested) list of children — same shape
     iodata uses for bytes. The painter walks the structure via
     `paint_kids/3` recursing into both list cells and VNode cells
     without ever materializing a flat list. This is what lets
     component code drop a list of memos straight into a VFlow
     alongside scalar children with no `++` and no `flat_map`.
     (See markdown wrapper in §13.)

  2. `%VMemo{thunk}` may return any VNode, including a list /
     VFlow. Per-block memoization (markdown commits one paragraph
     at a time, each becomes a VMemo) needs the thunk to be able
     to return a VFlow shape, not just a single subtree.

  3. Hook-cell values are stored by identity, never deep-compared.
     Components hold large structs (e.g. %MdRender{}) in cells; the
     reconciler treats `cell_value === previous_cell_value` as the
     only "unchanged" signal. Setter calls are the only way to mark
     a cell dirty.

  4. Setters called during render fold into the same paint pass
     (React's "derived state from props" pattern). No second-paint
     scheduled when a render function calls a setter from its own
     body. Documented in the hook semantics; tested explicitly.

Compat adapter wraps existing Component.render/2 outputs as VLines
so nothing changes visually.

Telemetry: [:octo_pi_tui, :vdom, :paint] reports nodes_visited /
memo_hits / memo_misses / line_count / byte_count / duration.

Hard rules: no `++`, no `flat_map`, no `List.flatten` in the hot
path. Component authors **never** type `++` to compose children;
violations are caught by a Credo check + a unit test that greps the
final `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components` tree for `\\+\\+`
in render code.

Tests: unit fixtures for border math, zone welding, padding, memo
hit/miss (including VMemo-returns-list and VFlow-with-nested-list-
children), cursor stamping through nested boxes, hook-cell identity
comparison, render-time setter folding.
title: VDom core: VNode types, LineBuf, paint phase, Compat adapter behind feature flag
